_comment: emtk forms of the MaxEnt MEM tool over MEMForm; the Qt tool builds the same fields by hand in gui/gui.py.

sections.title: MEM settings
sections.description: Mode, regularization and the iteration limit of the maximum-entropy inversion.

sections.label: Mode
sections.description: Invert a lifetime spectrum or a FRET-distance distribution (the FRET mode needs a donor-only spectrum).

sections.label: nu (reg)
sections.description: Entropy regularization weight: small values fit the noise, large ones smooth the distribution.

sections.label: MEM iterations
sections.description: Maximum iterations of the compiled MEM solver.

sections.title: Lifetime grid
sections.description: Evenly spaced lifetime grid of the inversion.

sections.label: tau min (ns)
sections.description: Smallest lifetime of the grid (set from the IRF width when data is taken from a fit).

sections.label: tau max (ns)
sections.description: Largest lifetime of the grid.

sections.label: tau points
sections.description: Number of grid points.

sections.title: Distance grid
sections.description: Donor reference, Foerster radius and the distance grid of the FRET inversion.

sections.label: tau0 (ns)
sections.description: Unquenched donor reference lifetime.

sections.label: R0 (A)
sections.description: Foerster radius used to convert FRET rates to distances.

sections.label: R/R0 min
sections.description: Lower distance boundary relative to R0.

sections.label: R/R0 max
sections.description: Upper distance boundary relative to R0.

sections.label: R points
sections.description: Number of distance grid points.

sections.label: donor-only fraction
sections.description: Fraction of unquenched donor in the sample.

sections.label: fix donor-only fraction
sections.description: Keep the donor-only fraction at its value during nuisance optimization.

sections.title: Periodic convolution
sections.description: Include the tails of earlier excitation pulses.

sections.label: Periodic convolution
sections.description: Include repeated excitation pulses instead of a single-shot decay.

sections.label: Period (ns)
sections.description: Pulse separation used with periodic convolution (initialised from the decay window).

sections.title: Instrument
sections.description: Response shift, backgrounds and scatter of the forward model.

sections.label: timeshift (ch)
sections.description: Response shift in histogram channels.

sections.label: background (cts)
sections.description: Constant decay background.

sections.label: IRF background (cts)
sections.description: Response baseline; zero selects the automatic baseline estimate.

sections.label: lamp scatter
sections.description: Fixed amplitude of scattered excitation light.

sections.title: Nuisance optimization
sections.description: Let the solver adjust the shift, background and IRF background, except the ones fixed here.

sections.label: Fit nuisance (ts/bg/IRF BG)
sections.description: Let the solver fit the timeshift, background and IRF background whose fix switches are off.

sections.label: fix timeshift
sections.description: Hold the timeshift at its value during nuisance optimization.

sections.label: fix background
sections.description: Hold the background at its value during nuisance optimization.

sections.label: fix IRF background
sections.description: Hold the IRF background at its value during nuisance optimization.

sections.title: L-curve
sections.description: Span of the 16-point regularization sweep around nu, in decades.

sections.label: decades below nu
sections.description: Decades below the current nu scanned by the L-curve.

sections.label: decades above nu
sections.description: Decades above the current nu scanned by the L-curve.

sections.title: Sampling
sections.description: Q-MCMC sampling of the distribution uncertainty.

sections.label: Q-MCMC steps
sections.description: Total ensemble steps.

sections.label: Q-MCMC thinning
sections.description: Keep every n-th step.

sections.label: Walkers (0=auto)
sections.description: Number of walkers; zero uses the sampler default.

sections.label: Chunk size (substeps)
sections.description: Steps per progress update and saved chunk.

sections.label: CPUs (0=auto)
sections.description: Worker processes; zero selects a platform default.

sections.label: Vectorized sampling
sections.description: Evaluate ensemble log probabilities in vectorized batches.
